summary: Restore configured provider models in the HTTP discovery catalog

delivery.outcome: OpenAI and Ollama model discovery expose the models configured by the operator on the first request and after a policy update.
nonGoals: Model execution and benchmark scheduling are managed independently.

architecture.decision: Load the operator policy inside the HTTP request context before projecting the existing proxy catalog.
architecture.rollback: Select the previous qualified runtime on each host. Repository rollback uses a reviewed revert.

validation.evidence: Both HTTP catalog formats expose configured models and reflect policy changes between requests. The invalid-policy fixture returns a structured 503.
